Subject: MedSys technical onramp: VPC / on-prem orchestration — initial scheduling

Hi everyone,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Per our roadmap discussion, the next step is a 90–120 minute architecture workshop to validate network topology, IAM boundaries, and procurement constraints for the VPC/on-prem integration. Goal: get the technical sign-off that lets us carve out the Dedicated capacity and prep the onboarding workstreams.

Suggested attendees (please add or correct):
- Marcus Reynolds (MedSys) — cloud infra lead
- Priya Shah (MedSys) — security PM
- Procurement (MedSys) — contract/procurement rep
- Camila Reyes (Redwood) — Solutions Engineer (SE lead)
- Hannah Schmitt (Redwood) — SE (network/IAM)
- Aditya Rao (Redwood) — AE (owner)
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — product lead (optional)

Proposed windows (PT):
- Thu Jul 29, 08:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Jul 29, 13:00–15:00 PT
- Fri Jul 30, 11:00–13:00 PT

Attachments: vpc-onprem-agenda.pdf (draft), connectivity-checklist.xlsx (preflight). I can also drop a shared folder. Please reply with the best slot and any additional attendees (procurement/security/cloud network owners).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the calendar once we have consensus.

—Aditya

My availability this week: Wed 07/27 09:00–11:00 PT (short notice), Thu 07/29 08:00–10:00 PT (preferred), Fri 07/30 11:00–13:00 PT. If any of these work, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a shared Drive folder with the agenda and checklist.

Thanks — Camila
